title: Pokemon TCG Ampharos Spirit Link Ancient Origins #70 Item Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Ampharos Spirit Link card from the Ancient Origins set is a sought-after item in the Pokémon TCG. This Trainer-Item card, numbered 70, features the character Ampharos in its Ancient form, making it a valuable addition to any collector's deck. Made of card stock with a regular finish, this item is suitable for ages 4 and up and is part of the Pokémon franchise, perfect for fans of the game looking to enhance their gameplay experience.
